blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – A witness in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte testified on Thursday that 11 people chipped in for a P200,000 meal in Tokyo, which was paid for using the credit card of Duterte’s husband, Atty. Manases Carpio. Anel Martin Antero took the witness stand in connection with the prosecution’s allegation that Duterte had amassed unexplained wealth and failed to truthfully disclose all her assets in her statement of assets, liabilities, and net worth (SALN). Prosecution witness Atty. Alexander Cabrera previously disclosed Duterte’s alleged “unusual banking behavior,” which included a meal at Ginza Inakaya Tokyo in Japan […]...
